title: Bounded mobile layout-shift source attribution with unchanged website quality gate
root_cause: UNPROVEN. Sitewide browser gate detected CLS 0.111 > 0.100 at phone /en/blog/afas-api after separately passing checkout; existing browser log gave scalar CLS without attributable shifted DOM elements. This learning item repairs diagnostic insufficiency, not the underlying CLS.
impact: The SEO release remains blocked and an ungrounded CSS guess could mask the defect or create regressions.
failed_approaches: Single numeric CLS score does not identify the shifting element
Treating successful checkout as passing all browser acceptance
Raising thresholds, skipping the AFAS page or blind reruns
fix: Preserve PerformanceObserver layout-shift entries with bounded sources, node labels and previous/current geometry. Emit their diagnostics only when the unchanged >0.100 gate fails.
prevention_rule: For an unexplained website CLS regression, capture real source nodes/old and new rectangles before changing layout; never waive original route, viewport or mobile CLS coverage; only verified source fix plus exact-head full CI and Netlify production readback can close the operating incident.
outcome: CANDIDATE diagnostics only; requires Protected Required/CodeQL and original visual CLS defect remains OBSERVED.

shadow: same threshold and visibility checks, diagnostic-only attribute capture
negative_canary: CLS 0.111 still fails threshold 0.100; no waiver
